item_short_desc: Rothco's Jolly Roger Web Belt takes the classic military web belt to the next level with a bold white skull and crossbones pattern that repeats around the entire belt. Crafted from durable, high-quality webbing, this belt is built for long-lasting use while offering a comfortable, adjustable fit. Whether you’re looking to add some style to your everyday outfits or complete a pirate costume, this belt provides the perfect combination of function and fashion.
